scores.evidence: The lesson uses です・ます throughout. Wrong-option feedback stays within 2 sentences, and the options in each question share the same form. One notation rule is broken: in s4-check, option c quotes the report text with 『』 rather than 「」, while the prompt quotes the same text with 「新しい課題はありません」. A few lines are clipped: p1-steps-write (p-run) has 「プランでなくAPIの料金です（第10回）。」, s2-lead has 「追加にします」 and the s2-code comment reads 「# 未追跡に出さない」. These are still readable, so the score is 3.

measure.mjs gives prose 2265 (budget 1,200–2,400), read 2653, practice reading 1246, 11 questions, 2 practice sections and est 20.0 min (must be ≤ 20). estMinutes is 20, so they match. lessons:lint --strict reports 0 errors and 0 warnings. Each segment adds at most 3 new terms: s1-defs adds ワークツリー and バックグラウンド実行, s3-lead adds 非対話的実行, and s4-defs adds 無人実行 and 定期タスク. Long material is split into lists: s3-table and s4-four.

The terms are defined before they are used. Katakana terms get English on first use: ワークツリー（worktree）, バックグラウンド実行（background execution）, トークン（token…）, シェル（shell…）, エージェントビュー（agent view…）. API is spelled out in p1-steps-write. The 第N回 references match content/courses/claude-code/course.json: 第2・4・6・7・8・10回. 分類器 and 信頼の確認 come from 第1・2回. Small gaps: in objective o2, 継続的インテグレーション has no English. In check-quiz e1, 「今の会話」 differs from the glossary's 「メインの会話」. Neither is likely to confuse the learner.
The one declared locale (jp) is complete. Lint reports no locale-plain-string findings. The only link, in s3-mode, names its destination: 「公式ドキュメント（非対話的実行）」. There are no diagram labels to localize.

mustFix.issue: (d) Notation (style-guide §3, quotes in 「」): option c quotes the report text with 『』, which is not nested inside another 「」. The prompt and the explanation quote the same kind of report with 「」.
mustFix.fix: 「新しい課題がないときは、『新しい課題はありません』と報告させる指示」→「新しい課題がないときは、「新しい課題はありません」と報告させる指示」
